inflation.title: Inflation rate (annual, latest month)
inflation.note: Consumer prices compared with the same month a year earlier: the headline inflation rate each country reports. Countries publish on different days, so each is shown at its latest month. IMF consumer price data; Australia from the ABS monthly CPI (the monthly CPI indicator before April 2025).

source.publisher: International Monetary Fund; Australian Bureau of Statistics

unemployment.title: Unemployment rate
unemployment.note: Share of the labour force out of work. National definitions differ a little between countries. IMF World Economic Outlook.

gov_debt.title: General government gross debt, % of GDP
gov_debt.note: All levels of government combined (federal, state and local), so it is higher than the Commonwealth-only figure on this site. IMF World Economic Outlook.

gov_balance.title: General government budget balance, % of GDP
gov_balance.note: Net lending (+) or borrowing (−) by all levels of government, as a share of GDP. IMF World Economic Outlook.

gov_spending.title: General government spending, % of GDP
gov_spending.note: Total expenditure by all levels of government, as a share of GDP. IMF Fiscal Monitor / World Economic Outlook.

gdp_pc.title: GDP per person (purchasing power, international dollars)
gdp_pc.note: GDP per person converted at purchasing power parity, so living costs are allowed for. Current prices. IMF World Economic Outlook.

growth.title: Real GDP growth
growth.note: Annual change in real (inflation-adjusted) GDP. IMF World Economic Outlook.

defence.title: Military spending, % of GDP
defence.note: SIPRI military expenditure as a share of GDP, published by the World Bank. SIPRI's definition is broader than the Defence budget line.
